prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean residential or commercial backflow (irrigation/pool/hydronic) and do you want me to find specific companies now? I can either give general guidance on where to find certified testers and what to ask, or — if you want — search and list local providers near Liberty, MO.

Quick guidance until I search:

- Who to call: licensed plumbers, irrigation companies, or backflow-specialty firms. Larger chains (Roto‑Rooter, Mr. Rooter) and many local plumbing/irrigation contractors offer testing and repairs.
- Certification: ask for a current backflow tester certification (make sure they are certified for your device type — RPZ, double-check, PVB, etc.). The City/utility may require certified testers and a specific test form.
- What to ask: cost for testing, cost estimate for repairs if it fails, proof of insurance, whether they will file the test with the city (if required), and warranty on repairs.
- Typical cost: testing is often about $75–$150 per assembly; repairs vary widely by part/labor.
- Where to search: Google Maps or Yelp for “backflow testing Liberty MO”; the City of Liberty water/wastewater dept or your local water utility often has a list of approved/certified testers.

If you want, tell me “Yes, find providers” (and confirm ZIP if you want the immediate Liberty area) and I’ll look up current options and list contact details and ratings.
